extract_fields.CustomerCode: the 2-digit customer code printed in large bold font on the label (e.g. '33')
extract_fields.OrderNumber: the value printed next to 'Номер заказа:'
extract_fields.BarcodeNumber: the human-readable code printed directly below the small barcode graphic at the very bottom of THIS Russian-language label, right next to the large '33' -- it should read the same as the 'Номер заказа' value above it. If more than one label/card appears in the photo, do NOT read a barcode belonging to a different label (e.g. a larger GS1-style barcode printed with parentheses like '(01)...(13)...' on a separate English pallet label is NOT this one)
extract_fields.ManufactureDate: the date printed next to 'Дата изготовления:', in d-mm-yy format (e.g. '8-09-26')
